verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਤਿ ਸਰੂਪੁ ਹੈ ਧਿਆਨ ਮੂਲੁ ਗੁਰ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਜਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: satigur sat saroop hai dhiaan mool gur moorat jaanai|

en.bdb: That the true Guru is the truth incarnate and is the basis of meditation is well known (to the gurmukh).

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮੂਲ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ੍ਰ ਸਿਮਰਣੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: sat naam karataa purakh mool ma(n)trr simaran paravaanai|

en.bdb: Satnam, Karta Purakh is accepted as the basic formula, the root mantra, by the gurmukh.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਰਸੁ ਪੂਜਾ ਮੂਲੁ ਪਿਰਮ ਰਸੁ ਮਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: charan kaval makara(n)dh ras poojaa mool piram ras maanai|

en.bdb: He accepting the sweet sap of the lotus feet as fundamental, quaffs the joy of love for the supreme.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਆਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: sabadh surat liv saadhasa(n)g gur kirapaa te a(n)dhar aanai|

en.bdb: He enters into the immersion of word-consciousness through the Guru and the holy congregation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਥੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਚਲਣੁ ਭਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh pa(n)th aga(n)m hai gurmat nihachal chalan bhaanai|

en.bdb: The way of the gurmukh is beyond the ken of mind  and speech and he in accordance with the wisdom of the Guru and his own steadfast will, treads on it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵੇਦ ਕਤੇਬਹੁਂ ਬਾਹਰੀ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਕਉਣੁ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: vedh katebahu(n) baaharee akath kathaa kaun aakh vakhaanai|

en.bdb: Who can describe the importance of the parable (of the gurmukh) because it is beyond the Vedas and the Katebas, (the  four holy books of semitic religion).
This way can be identified only by crossing the limits and anxieties about the high and low of the world.
